title: Restoration of euglycemia in the RCS10 mice with Metformin
author: Ian Simpson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8e4htgw

steps.title: Prepare Metformin and Saccharin drinking water
steps.instruction: Prepare drinking water containing Metformin and 0.15% saccharin for RCS10 mice to ensure sufficient consumption and mask the taste of Metformin.

substeps.instruction: Adjust saccharin levels in control mice water to normalize saccharin consumption across groups.

steps.title: Administer Metformin to RCS10 mice
steps.instruction: Administer Metformin to 20-week-old RCS10 mice (diabetic for at least 4 weeks) via drinking water to restore euglycemia.

substeps.instruction: Deliver Metformin at a dosage of 0.8-1.3 g/kg/D.
Increase Metformin concentration in the drinking water from 100-120 mg/ml over the course of 4 weeks to maintain euglycemia.

steps.title: Induce stroke via hypoxia
steps.instruction: Expose both saccharin control mice (n=8) and Metformin-treated mice (n=15) to 22 minutes of 9% oxygen.

steps.title: Assess stroke outcome
steps.instruction: Determine the extent of stroke damage 48 hours after the infarct.

substeps.instruction: Perform H&E staining of sections to evaluate infarct volume.
